# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 and documentation** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and ships XML API documentation with its NuGet packages. The release aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154, updates HarfBuzzSharp generation to its bundled native source, and makes package documentation available to consumers.

## Breaking Changes

- **HarfBuzzSharp corrects the CCC132 enum name** — `UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133` has been renamed to `CCC132` to match upstream HarfBuzz while retaining numeric value 132. Update source references to the corrected member name. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **HarfBuzzSharp no longer exposes aggregate Defined flags** — `GlyphFlags.Defined` is removed, and aggregate `Defined` members are not exposed for buffer flags. Combine the concrete flags your application needs when constructing a mask. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates its upstream bug fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))
- **HarfBuzzSharp generation follows the bundled native source** — Bindings are generated from the HarfBuzz revision pinned by Skia, keeping ordinary managed declarations synchronized with the native library while excluding unsupported callback-heavy APIs. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056), [#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## API Surface

- **XML API documentation ships with packages** — NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation, making API comments available to IDE tooling alongside the managed assemblies. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 generates its bindings from the same DEPS-pinned source as the bundled native library, synchronizing supported declarations with that release.
